import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:logging/logging.dart';
import 'package:xta/client/client_unauthenticated.dart';
import 'package:xta/client/endpoints.dart';
import 'package:xta/client/headers.dart';
import 'package:xta/constants.dart';

// Temporary probe, copied into test/live by the workflow: does X accept the
// signature derived from the sign-in page on guest requests?
void main() {
  test('signed against unsigned', () async {
    final token = await getToken(Logger('probe'));
    final client = http.Client();
    const vars = {
      'userId': '783214',
      'screen_name': 'X',
      'screenName': 'X',
      'count': 20,
      'focalTweetId': '20',
      'tweetId': '20',
      'listId': '1',
      'id': '1',
      'rawQuery': 'nasa',
      'querySource': 'typed_query',
      'product': 'Latest',
      'includePromotedContent': false,
      'withVoice': true,
      'includePromoted': false,
    };
    Future<void> probe(String label, Uri uri) async {
      for (final signed in [false, true]) {
        final signedHeaders = signed ? await TwitterHeaders.getHeaders(uri, null) : <String, String>{};
        final response = await client.get(
          uri,
          headers: {
            ...signedHeaders,
            'authorization': guestBearerToken,
            'x-guest-token': token,
            'content-type': 'application/json',
            'user-agent':
                'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/127.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
          },
        );
        final body = response.body.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
        // ignore: avoid_print
        print(
          '${label.padRight(24)} ${signed ? 'signed  ' : 'unsigned'} ${response.statusCode} '
          '${body.substring(0, min(110, body.length))}',
        );
        await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 700));
      }
    }

    for (final endpoint in XEndpoints.all) {
      await probe(
        endpoint.name,
        XEndpoints.uri(endpoint.name, {
          'variables': jsonEncode(vars),
          'features': jsonEncode(const <String, bool>{}),
        }),
      );
    }
    await probe(
      'BOGUS TweetDetail',
      Uri.https('x.com', '/i/api/graphql/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA/TweetDetail', {'variables': jsonEncode(vars)}),
    );

    // The canary's own way: TwitterHeaders' bearer with the guest token.
    Future<void> canaryWay(String label, Uri uri) async {
      final headers = await TwitterHeaders.getHeaders(uri, null);
      final response = await client.get(uri, headers: {...headers, 'x-guest-token': token});
      final body = response.body.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
      // ignore: avoid_print
      print('${label.padRight(24)} canary   ${response.statusCode} ${body.substring(0, min(140, body.length))}');
      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 700));
    }

    const canaryVars = {'userId': '783214', 'screenName': 'X', 'count': 1};
    for (final name in [XEndpoints.tweetDetail, XEndpoints.userByScreenName, XEndpoints.following]) {
      await canaryWay(
        name,
        XEndpoints.uri(name, {'variables': jsonEncode(canaryVars), 'features': jsonEncode(const <String, bool>{})}),
      );
    }
    for (final host in ['x.com', 'twitter.com']) {
      await canaryWay(
        'BOGUS on $host',
        Uri.https(host, '/i/api/graphql/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA/TweetDetail', {
          'variables': jsonEncode(canaryVars),
          'features': jsonEncode(const <String, bool>{}),
        }),
      );
    }
  }, timeout: const Timeout(Duration(minutes: 4)));
}
